Release Notes
                                                                                                              PocketBook InkPad Color 3
                                                                                 FW Version: 6.10.2854


FW Version: 6.10.2854 (January 05, 2026)





Core changes

   1. New Pocketbook x Libby App Added – A new app provides access to public libraries,
      allowing users to read e-books or listen to audiobooks from their local library. Users
     can search for a library by name, postcode, or city, filter by country, and either
     preview content or sign in with a library card to borrow books. Borrowed titles
     can be read offline in the built-in reader or listened to online, with options to place
      holds, manage loans, and return books early. The app also provides a shelf for
      quick access to current books, and an intuitive menu to switch libraries or manage
       library cards.

   2. New Feature: Device PIN Code Support.

     Implemented full support for PIN code protection on devices. Users can now secure
       their devices by setting a 4- or 6-digit PIN code through the system settings. During
      setup, an email address must be linked to enable PIN recovery; confirmation is
      required via a link sent to the provided email. The PIN itself is securely stored
       locally as a hash — it is never transmitted to the server. Users have the ability to
     change or remove the PIN, as well as to update or unlink the recovery email.

     The system allows flexible control over when the PIN is required: on device startup,
      unlock, USB connection, or disconnection.  If the user forgets the PIN, a recovery
     flow is available after several failed attempts — this includes sending a signed
      request to the server and verifying the user through a secure email link. Wi-Fi can
     be enabled even on a locked device to support this recovery scenario. After a full
      factory reset, the PIN code is cleared and must be configured again if needed.

   3. Introduced a new, enhanced logo customization feature that gives users greater
      control over the appearance of the device during startup and shutdown. Users can
    now personalize the Boot and Power-off logos by selecting from several options:
     use the default system image, show the cover of the currently opened book, or
     even display the current page as a dynamic screen saver. For a more personalized
      experience, users may also choose any custom image stored on the device or select
     up to 10 images to be shown in random order. Additionally, for Power-off mode,
      there is an option to display no image at all. These new options are available under

      Settings > Personalize > Logos and provide a more tailored and visually engaging
      experience every time the device is used.

   4. Added display options for book cover logos (boot and power-off). Users can now
     choose how the empty space around the book cover is filled — Fill screen, White
     background (default), Black background, or Depth effect.

   5. Accessibility Support Added – The device now includes enhanced accessibility fea-
      tures designed to assist users with visual impairments or reading difficulties, as well
      as those who wish to personalize their reading comfort. Users can customize the
      UI text by adjusting Text Size, enabling Bold Text, increasing Grey Text Contrast,
     and using a Dyslexic Font for improved readability.  In addition, Screen Reader
    mode provides spoken feedback to help users navigate and interact with the de-
      vice independently and intuitively. These features aim to provide an inclusive and
     independent reading experience for all users.

   6. Added support for logging into multiple Onleihe libraries and switching between
     them.

   7. Added support for LCP-protected PDF files

   8. Added support for LCP-protected audio files

   9. Updated the system framework to the latest versions to enhance security, reliability,
     and compatibility with modern technologies.

 10. Upgraded the Browser app’s web engine to Chrome 122 to deliver a faster, more
      secure, and smoother web experience, with improved support for modern websites
     and web technologies.

 11. Added Icelandic to the list of available languages in the device user interface.

 12. Flac audio format support


Reading program

   1. Resolved an issue where some books with a large number of pages (1000 or more)
     opened slowly or failed to open at all.

   2. Resolved an issue where some EPUB books with fixed layout did not utilize the full
      screen area of the device.

   3. Fixed an issue where cover images of some EPUB books did not display fullscreen
     on the device.

   4. Fixed an issue where hyphenation in some Portuguese-language books was incor-
       rectly applied.

   5. Fixed an issue where certain EPUB files displayed an excessively high page count
     due to duplicated chapters

   6. Fixed cases where marker-based text selection could behave incorrectly in EPUB2
     and EPUB3 files. In some cases, highlighting was not possible or inaccurate, could
     jump or disappear during interaction, expand incorrectly across multiple lines, or
        fail to select trailing characters at the end of paragraphs.

   7. Ukrainian TTS voice is now available for download and install


Other improvements

   1. Added ”+” and ”–” buttons in the Advanced Frontlight Settings for more precise
      frontlight adjustment.

   2. Added icons to indicate supported Bluetooth services (e.g., audio devices via A2DP,
      input devices via HID) in the list of discovered devices, helping users identify which
      devices can be used with the system.

   3. Resolved an issue that could cause some Bluetooth headsets to disconnect during
     music playback

   4. Fixed an issue where audio playback was not correctly routed to previously con-
     nected Bluetooth headphones after restarting Bluetooth; sound was sent directly
      to the device speaker instead.

   5. Fixed an intermittent issue with Adobe DRM activation during user registration and
      authorization in PocketBook Store. In some cases, successful registration or login
      did not display confirmation messages nor show Adobe DRM account details in
      Settings > Accounts and Synchronization, and an error message appeared after
      registration. Now, users consistently receive appropriate success notifications, and
     Adobe DRM account information is correctly displayed after both registration and
      authorization processes.

   6. Corrected the time zone for Almaty from GMT+6 to GMT+5.
